export function AgentRunDetails({ tab, selectedRunId, selectedRunQuery, selectedRun, traceSteps, setTab }: Props) {
    if (tab !== "trace" && tab !== "sources" && tab !== "output") return null;
    if (!selectedRunId) {
        const title = tab === "trace" ? "Trace" : tab === "sources" ? "Sources" : "Output";
        return (
            <SectionCard title={title} description="Select or create a run first.">
                <EmptyState
                    icon={<Bot />}
                    title="No run selected"
                    description="Run an agent or pick a history item on the Run tab."
                    action={<Button variant="default" onClick={() => setTab("run")} type="button">Open Run</Button>}
                />
            </SectionCard>
        );
    }
    return (
        <QueryBoundary
            isLoading={selectedRunQuery.isLoading}
            isError={selectedRunQuery.isError}
            error={selectedRunQuery.error}
            onRetry={() => void selectedRunQuery.refetch()}
        >
            {selectedRun ? (
                tab === "trace" ? <AgentTraceDetails run={selectedRun} traceSteps={traceSteps} />
                    : tab === "sources" ? <AgentSourcesDetails run={selectedRun} />
                        : <AgentOutputDetails run={selectedRun} setTab={setTab} />
            ) : null}
        </QueryBoundary>
    );
}

export function AgentRunHistory({ history, runsQuery, selectedRunId, setSelectedRunId, setTab }: Props) {
    return (
                        <SectionCard
                            title="Run history"
                            description="Persisted runs for your account. Select one to inspect Trace, Sources, and Output."
                        >
                            <div className="flex gap-ui-sm">
                                <Button
                                    variant="ghost"
                                    onClick={() => void runsQuery.refetch()}
                                    disabled={runsQuery.isFetching}
                                    type="button">
                                    {runsQuery.isFetching ? "Refreshing…" : "Refresh history"}
                                </Button>
                                <QueryBoundary
                                    isLoading={runsQuery.isLoading}
                                    isError={runsQuery.isError}
                                    error={runsQuery.error}
                                    onRetry={() => void runsQuery.refetch()}
                                >
                                    {history.length === 0 ? (
                                        <EmptyState
                                            icon={<Bot />}
                                            title="No agent runs yet"
                                            description="Submit a run to inspect response, citations, cost, and degradation."
                                        />
                                    ) : (
                                        <div className="min-w-0 max-w-full overflow-x-auto">
                                            <table className="w-full text-body-md">
                                                <thead>
                                                    <tr className="border-b border-border">
                                                        <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">Run</td>
                                                        <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">Status</td>
                                                        <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">Model</td>
                                                        <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">Duration</td>
                                                        <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">When</td>
                                                        <td align="right" className="p-ui-xs align-top">Open</td>
                                                    </tr>
                                                </thead>
                                                <tbody>
                                                    {history.map((run) => (
                                                        <tr key={run.id} className="border-b border-border">
                                                            <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">
                                                                {run.id.slice(0, 8)}…
                                                                {run.agent_id
                                                                    ? ` · ${run.agent_id}`
                                                                    : ""}
                                                            </td>
                                                            <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">
                                                                <RunStatusBadge status={run.status} />
                                                            </td>
                                                            <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">
                                                                {run.provider_key}/
                                                                {run.model_name}
                                                            </td>
                                                            <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">
                                                                {run.latency_ms != null
                                                                    ? formatElapsed(run.latency_ms)
                                                                    : "—"}
                                                            </td>
                                                            <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">
                                                                {new Date(
                                                                    run.created_at
                                                                ).toLocaleString()}
                                                            </td>
                                                            <td align="right" className="p-ui-xs align-top">
                                                                <Button
                                                                    variant={
                                                                        selectedRunId === run.id
                                                                            ? "default"
                                                                            : "outline"
                                                                    }
                                                                    onClick={() => {
                                                                        setSelectedRunId(run.id);
                                                                        setTab("output");
                                                                    }}
                                                                    type="button">
                                                                    {`${run.id.slice(0, 8)}… · ${run.status}`}
                                                                </Button>
                                                            </td>
                                                        </tr>
                                                    ))}
                                                </tbody>
                                            </table>
                                        </div>
                                    )}
                                </QueryBoundary>
                            </div>
                        </SectionCard>
    );
}

                                                                    variant={

                                                                            ? "default"

                                                                    type="button">
                                                                    {`${run.id.slice(0, 8)}… · ${run.status}`}
                                                                </Button>
                                                            </td>
                                                        </tr>
                                                    ))}

export function EvaluationDatasetBuilder({model}: Props) {
    const m = model;
    const {
        datasetForm,
        setDatasetForm,
        createDatasetMutation,
        selectedDatasetId,
        setSelectedDatasetId,
        datasets,
        datasetCaseForm,
        setDatasetCaseForm,
        createDatasetCaseMutation,
        runForm,
        setRunForm,
        selectedTemplateVersions,
        runEvaluationMutation,
        notify
    } = model;
    return (
        <div className="flex gap-ui-sm">

            <p>Evaluation datasets</p>
            <FormField
                label="Dataset name"
                value={datasetForm.name}
                onChange={(event: any) => setDatasetForm((current) => ({...current, name: event.target.value}))}/>
            <FormField
                label="Dataset description"
                value={datasetForm.description}
                onChange={(event: any) => setDatasetForm((current) => ({
                    ...current,
                    description: event.target.value
                }))}/>
            <Button
                variant="outline"
                disabled={createDatasetMutation.isPending || !datasetForm.name.trim()}
                onClick={() => createDatasetMutation.mutate(datasetForm)}
                type="button">
                {createDatasetMutation.isPending ? "Creating..." : "Create evaluation dataset"}
            </Button>
            <FormField
                as="select"
                label="Selected dataset"
                value={selectedDatasetId}
                onChange={(event: any) => setSelectedDatasetId(event.target.value)}>
                {datasets.map((dataset) => (
                    <option key={dataset.id}>
                        {dataset.name}
                    </option>
                ))}
            </FormField>
            <FormField
                label="Case input variables JSON"
                value={datasetCaseForm.input_variables_json}
                onChange={(event: any) => setDatasetCaseForm((current) => ({
                    ...current,
                    input_variables_json: event.target.value
                }))}
                as="textarea"
                rows={4}/>
            <FormField
                label="Retrieval query"
                value={datasetCaseForm.retrieval_query}
                onChange={(event: any) => setDatasetCaseForm((current) => ({
                    ...current,
                    retrieval_query: event.target.value
                }))}/>
            <FormField
                label="Expected chunk IDs"
                description="Comma-separated chunk IDs used to calculate citation hit rate."
                value={datasetCaseForm.expected_chunk_ids}
                onChange={(event: any) => setDatasetCaseForm((current) => ({
                    ...current,
                    expected_chunk_ids: event.target.value
                }))}/>
            <div className="flex flex-row gap-ui-xs flex-wrap">
                {m.documents.map((document) => {
                    const selected =
                        m.selectedEvaluationDocumentIds.includes(document.id);

                    return (
                        <Button
                            key={document.id}
                            type="button"
                            variant={selected ? "default" : "outline"}
                            size="sm"
                            aria-pressed={selected}
                            onClick={() => m.toggleEvaluationDocument(document.id)}
                        >
                            {document.title}
                        </Button>
                    );
                })}
            </div>
            <FormField
                label="Expected output text"
                value={datasetCaseForm.expected_output_text}
                onChange={(event: any) => setDatasetCaseForm((current) => ({
                    ...current,
                    expected_output_text: event.target.value
                }))}
                as="textarea"
                rows={2}/>
            <FormField
                label="Expected output JSON"
                value={datasetCaseForm.expected_output_json}
                onChange={(event: any) => setDatasetCaseForm((current) => ({
                    ...current,
                    expected_output_json: event.target.value
                }))}
                as="textarea"
                rows={2}/>
            <FormField
                label="Notes"
                value={datasetCaseForm.notes}
                onChange={(event: any) => setDatasetCaseForm((current) => ({...current, notes: event.target.value}))}/>
            <Button
                variant="outline"
                disabled={createDatasetCaseMutation.isPending || !selectedDatasetId}
                onClick={() => {
                    const result = datasetCaseDraftSchema.safeParse(datasetCaseForm);
                    if (!result.success) {
                        notify({message: firstSchemaError(result), severity: "error"});
                        return;
                    }
                    try {
                        createDatasetCaseMutation.mutate({
                            datasetId: selectedDatasetId,
                            payload: {
                                input_variables: parseJsonObject(result.data.input_variables_json),
                                retrieval_query: result.data.retrieval_query || null,
                                document_ids: m.selectedEvaluationDocumentIds,
                                expected_chunk_ids: result.data.expected_chunk_ids.split(",").map((id) => id.trim()).filter(Boolean),
                                expected_output_text: result.data.expected_output_text || null,
                                expected_output_json: result.data.expected_output_json.trim()
                                    ? parseJsonObject(result.data.expected_output_json)
                                    : null,
                                notes: result.data.notes || null,
                            },
                        });
                    } catch (error) {
                        notify({
                            message: getQueryErrorMessage(error, "Invalid dataset case JSON."),
                            severity: "error",
                        });
                    }
                }}
                type="button">
                {createDatasetCaseMutation.isPending ? "Saving..." : "Add dataset case"}
            </Button>
            <FormField
                as="select"
                label="Prompt version for evaluation"
                value={runForm.prompt_version_id}
                onChange={(event: any) => setRunForm((current) => ({
                    ...current,
                    prompt_version_id: event.target.value
                }))}>
                {selectedTemplateVersions.map((version) => (
                    <option key={version.id}>
                        v{version.version_number} • {version.model_name}
                    </option>
                ))}
            </FormField>
            <Button
                variant="default"
                disabled={runEvaluationMutation.isPending || !selectedDatasetId || !runForm.prompt_version_id}
                onClick={() => runEvaluationMutation.mutate({
                    datasetId: selectedDatasetId,
                    promptVersionId: runForm.prompt_version_id
                })}
                type="button">
                {runEvaluationMutation.isPending ? "Starting..." : "Run evaluation"}
            </Button>
        </div>
    );
}

export function EvaluationResults({ model }: Props) {
    const { selectedDatasetId, datasetCasesIsError, datasetCasesError, refetchDatasetCases, datasetCasesLoading, selectedDatasetCases, evaluationRunsIsError, evaluationRunsError, refetchEvaluationRuns, evaluationRunsLoading, evaluationRuns } = model;
    return (
        <>
                    {selectedDatasetId && datasetCasesIsError && (
                        <QueryErrorAlert
                            error={datasetCasesError}
                            fallback="Failed to load dataset cases."
                            onRetry={() => void refetchDatasetCases()}
                        />
                    )}
                    {selectedDatasetId && datasetCasesLoading ? (
                        <div className="flex gap-ui-xs">
                            {Array.from({ length: 2 }).map((_: any, index: any) => (
                                <div
                                    key={index}
                                    className="animate-pulse rounded-md bg-muted" />
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    ) : selectedDatasetCases.length > 0 ? (
                        <div className="flex gap-ui-xs">
                            {selectedDatasetCases.map((item) => (
                                <div key={item.id} className="rounded-md border border-border p-ui-sm">
                                    {recordToKeyValueItems(item.input_variables).length ? (
                                        <KeyValueList
                                            dense
                                            items={recordToKeyValueItems(item.input_variables)}
                                        />
                                    ) : (
                                        <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                                            No input variables
                                        </p>
                                    )}
                                    <AdvancedSettings title="Raw input variables" className="mt-1">
                                        <JsonBlock data={item.input_variables} />
                                    </AdvancedSettings>
                                    {item.expected_output_text && (
                                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                                            Expected: {item.expected_output_text}
                                        </span>
                                    )}
                                    {item.expected_chunk_ids.length > 0 && (
                                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                                            Expected chunks: {item.expected_chunk_ids.length}
                                        </span>
                                    )}
                                </div>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    ) : null}
                    {evaluationRunsIsError && (
                        <QueryErrorAlert
                            error={evaluationRunsError}
                            fallback="Failed to load evaluation runs."
                            onRetry={() => void refetchEvaluationRuns()}
                        />
                    )}
                    {evaluationRunsLoading ? (
                        <div className="flex gap-ui-xs">
                            {Array.from({ length: 2 }).map((_: any, index: any) => (
                                <div
                                    key={index}

                                    className="animate-pulse rounded-md bg-muted rounded-md" />
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    ) : evaluationRuns.length > 0 ? (
                        <div className="flex gap-ui-xs">
                            {evaluationRuns.map((run) => (
                                <div
                                    key={run.id}
                                    role="alert"
                                    className="rounded-lg border border-border p-ui-sm text-body-md">
                                    {formatDateTime(run.created_at)}:{" "}
                                    {run.status === "running"
                                        ? `Running (${run.total_cases} cases)...`
                                        : run.status === "failed"
                                          ? "Evaluation failed"
                                          : `${run.passed_cases}/${run.total_cases} passed, average score ${run.average_score}`}
                                </div>
                            ))}
                        </div>
                    ) : null}
        </>
    );
}

export function PromptLibraryPanel({m}: { m: AiStudioModel }) {
    const {
        templateForm,
        setTemplateForm,
        createTemplateMutation,
        promptTemplates,
        setSelectedTemplateId,
        selectedTemplateId
    } = m;
    return (
        <SectionCard title="Prompt library"
                     description="Create reusable prompt templates and publish versioned variants with rollout and pricing metadata.">
            <div className="flex gap-ui-md">
                <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-ui-sm">
                    <FormField
                        label="Template key"
                        value={templateForm.key}
                        onChange={(event: any) => setTemplateForm((current) => ({
                            ...current,
                            key: event.target.value
                        }))}/>
                    <FormField
                        label="Name"
                        value={templateForm.name}
                        onChange={(event: any) => setTemplateForm((current) => ({
                            ...current,
                            name: event.target.value
                        }))}/>
                </div>
                <FormField
                    label="Description"
                    value={templateForm.description}
                    onChange={(event: any) => setTemplateForm((current) => ({
                        ...current,
                        description: event.target.value
                    }))}
                    as="textarea"
                    rows={2}/>
                <Button
                    variant="default"
                    onClick={() => createTemplateMutation.mutate(templateForm)}
                    disabled={createTemplateMutation.isPending || !templateForm.key.trim() || !templateForm.name.trim()}
                    type="button">
                    {createTemplateMutation.isPending ? "Creating..." : "Create prompt template"}
                </Button>
                {promptTemplates.length > 0 ? (
                    <div className="flex gap-ui-sm">
                        {promptTemplates.map((template) => (
                            <div key={template.id} className="surface-card ui-feature-surface">
                                <div className="flex gap-ui-xs">
                                    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-ui-xs justify-between">
                                        <div>
                                            <p>{template.name}</p>
                                            <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                                                {template.key}
                                            </p>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="flex flex-row gap-ui-xs flex-wrap">
                                            {template.is_active && (
                                                <Badge variant="success">active</Badge>
                                            )}

                                            {template.active_version_id && (
                                                <Badge variant="outline">version pinned</Badge>
                                            )}
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    {template.description && (
                                        <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                                            {template.description}
                                        </p>
                                    )}
                                    <Button
                                        variant="outline"
                                        onClick={() => setSelectedTemplateId(template.id)}
                                        type="button">
                                        {selectedTemplateId === template.id ? "Selected" : "Manage versions"}
                                    </Button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    <EmptyState
                        icon={<Sparkles/>}
                        title="No prompts yet"
                        description="Create your first prompt template to start building reusable AI behaviors."
                    />
                )}
            </div>
        </SectionCard>
    );
}

export function VersionBuilderPanel({m}: { m: AiStudioModel }) {
    const {
        selectedTemplateId,
        setSelectedTemplateId,
        promptTemplates,
        versionForm,
        setVersionForm,
        providers,
        createVersionMutation,
        parseVariableDefinitions,
        versionsIsError,
        versionsError,
        refetchVersions,
        versionsLoading,
        selectedTemplateVersions,
        activateVersionMutation,
        publishVersionMutation
    } = m;
    return (
        <SectionCard title="Version builder"
                     description="Attach deployable versions to a prompt template with model selection, rollout state, and provider pricing.">
            <div className="flex gap-ui-md">
                <FormField
                    as="select"
                    label="Selected template"
                    value={selectedTemplateId}
                    onChange={(event: any) => setSelectedTemplateId(event.target.value)}>
                    {promptTemplates.map((template) => (
                        <option key={template.id}>
                            {template.name}
                        </option>
                    ))}
                </FormField>
                <FormField
                    as="select"
                    label="Provider"
                    value={versionForm.provider_key}
                    onChange={(event: any) => setVersionForm((current) => ({
                        ...current,
                        provider_key: event.target.value
                    }))}>
                    {providers.map((provider) => (
                        <option key={provider.key}>
                            {provider.label}
                        </option>
                    ))}
                </FormField>
                <FormField
                    label="Model name"
                    value={versionForm.model_name}
                    onChange={(event: any) => setVersionForm((current) => ({
                        ...current,
                        model_name: event.target.value
                    }))}/>
                <FormField
                    label="System prompt"
                    value={versionForm.system_prompt}
                    onChange={(event: any) => setVersionForm((current) => ({
                        ...current,
                        system_prompt: event.target.value
                    }))}
                    as="textarea"
                    rows={3}/>
                <FormField
                    label="User prompt template"
                    value={versionForm.user_prompt_template}
                    onChange={(event: any) => setVersionForm((current) => ({
                        ...current,
                        user_prompt_template: event.target.value
                    }))}
                    as="textarea"
                    rows={5}/>
                <FormField
                    label="Variable names (comma separated)"
                    value={versionForm.variable_names}
                    onChange={(event: any) => setVersionForm((current) => ({
                        ...current,
                        variable_names: event.target.value
                    }))}/>
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-ui-sm">
                    <FormField
                        as="select"
                        label="Response format"
                        value={versionForm.response_format}
                        onChange={(event: any) => setVersionForm((current) => ({
                            ...current,
                            response_format: event.target.value as "text" | "json"
                        }))}>
                        <option>Text</option>
                        <option>JSON</option>
                    </FormField>
                    <FormField
                        label="Temperature"
                        value={versionForm.temperature}
                        onChange={(event: any) => setVersionForm((current) => ({
                            ...current,
                            temperature: event.target.value
                        }))}/>
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-ui-sm">
                    <FormField
                        label="Rollout %"
                        value={versionForm.rollout_percentage}
                        onChange={(event: any) => setVersionForm((current) => ({
                            ...current,
                            rollout_percentage: event.target.value
                        }))}/>
                    <Switch
                        aria-label="Publish prompt version"
                        checked={versionForm.is_published}
                        onCheckedChange={(checked) => setVersionForm((current) => ({
                            ...current,
                            is_published: checked
                        }))}
                    />
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-ui-sm">
                    <FormField
                        label="Input cost / million"
                        value={versionForm.input_cost_per_million}
                        onChange={(event: any) => setVersionForm((current) => ({
                            ...current,
                            input_cost_per_million: event.target.value
                        }))}/>
                    <FormField
                        label="Output cost / million"
                        value={versionForm.output_cost_per_million}
                        onChange={(event: any) => setVersionForm((current) => ({
                            ...current,
                            output_cost_per_million: event.target.value
                        }))}/>
                </div>
                <Button
                    variant="default"
                    disabled={createVersionMutation.isPending || !selectedTemplateId || !versionForm.model_name.trim() || !versionForm.user_prompt_template.trim()}
                    onClick={() => {
                        const result = promptVersionDraftSchema.safeParse(versionForm);
                        if (!result.success) {
                            m.notify({message: firstSchemaError(result), severity: "error"});
                            return;
                        }
                        createVersionMutation.mutate({
                            templateId: selectedTemplateId,
                            payload: {
                                provider_key: result.data.provider_key,
                                model_name: result.data.model_name,
                                system_prompt: result.data.system_prompt,
                                user_prompt_template: result.data.user_prompt_template,
                                variable_definitions: parseVariableDefinitions(result.data.variable_names),
                                response_format: result.data.response_format,
                                temperature: Number(result.data.temperature),
                                rollout_percentage: Number(result.data.rollout_percentage),
                                is_published: result.data.is_published,
                                input_cost_per_million: Number(result.data.input_cost_per_million),
                                output_cost_per_million: Number(result.data.output_cost_per_million),
                            },
                        });
                    }}
                    type="button">
                    {createVersionMutation.isPending ? "Saving..." : "Create prompt version"}
                </Button>
                {selectedTemplateId && versionsIsError && (
                    <QueryErrorAlert
                        error={versionsError}
                        fallback="Failed to load prompt versions."
                        onRetry={() => void refetchVersions()}
                    />
                )}
                {selectedTemplateId && versionsLoading ? (
                    <div className="flex gap-ui-sm">
                        {Array.from({length: 2}).map((_: any, index: any) => (
                            <div
                                key={index}
                                className="animate-pulse rounded-md bg-muted"/>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                ) : selectedTemplateVersions.length > 0 ? (
                    <div className="flex gap-ui-sm">
                        {selectedTemplateVersions.map((version) => (
                            <div key={version.id} className="rounded-lg border border-border p-ui-md">
                                <div className="flex gap-ui-xs">
                                    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-ui-xs justify-between">
                                        <p>
                                            v{version.version_number} • {version.provider_key}/{version.model_name}
                                        </p>
                                        <div className="flex flex-row gap-ui-xs flex-wrap">
                                            {version.is_published && (
                                                <Badge variant="success">
                                                    published
                                                </Badge>
                                            )}

                                            <Badge variant="outline">
                                                {version.rollout_percentage}% rollout
                                            </Badge>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>
                                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                                        {version.user_prompt_template.slice(0, 180)}
                                    </p>
                                    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-ui-xs">
                                        <Button
                                            variant="outline"
                                            onClick={() => activateVersionMutation.mutate({
                                                templateId: selectedTemplateId,
                                                versionId: version.id
                                            })}
                                            type="button">
                                            Set active
                                        </Button>
                                        <Button
                                            variant="outline"
                                            onClick={() => publishVersionMutation.mutate({
                                                templateId: selectedTemplateId,
                                                versionId: version.id,
                                                isPublished: !version.is_published
                                            })}
                                            type="button">
                                            {version.is_published ? "Unpublish" : "Publish"}
                                        </Button>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                ) : null}
            </div>
        </SectionCard>
    );
}

export function RetrievalDocumentsPanel({ m }: { m: AiStudioModel }) {
    const { textDocumentForm, setTextDocumentForm, createTextDocumentMutation, uploadDocumentMutation, uploadDescription, setUploadDescription, documents } = m;
    return (
        <SectionCard title="Retrieval documents" description="Ingest source files or direct text, chunk them, and use them as retrieval context in prompt runs.">
            <div className="flex gap-ui-md">
                <FormField
                    label="Document title"
                    value={textDocumentForm.title}
                    onChange={(event: any) => setTextDocumentForm((current) => ({ ...current, title: event.target.value }))} />
                <FormField
                    label="Description"
                    value={textDocumentForm.description}
                    onChange={(event: any) => setTextDocumentForm((current) => ({ ...current, description: event.target.value }))} />
                <FormField
                    label="Document content"
                    value={textDocumentForm.content}
                    onChange={(event: any) => setTextDocumentForm((current) => ({ ...current, content: event.target.value }))}
                    as="textarea"
                    rows={6} />
                <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    disabled={createTextDocumentMutation.isPending || !textDocumentForm.title.trim() || !textDocumentForm.content.trim()}
                    onClick={() => createTextDocumentMutation.mutate(textDocumentForm)}
                    type="button">
                    {createTextDocumentMutation.isPending ? "Ingesting..." : "Create text document"}
                </Button>
                <Button
                    variant="default"
                    disabled={uploadDocumentMutation.isPending}
                    render={<label />}
                    type="button">
                    {uploadDocumentMutation.isPending ? "Uploading..." : "Upload text/markdown/json file"}
                    <input
                        hidden
                        type="file"
                        accept=".txt,.md,.json,.ndjson,text/plain,text/markdown,application/json"
                        onChange={(event: any) => {
                            const file = event.target.files?.[0];
                            if (file) {
                                uploadDocumentMutation.mutate({ file, description: uploadDescription || undefined });
                            }
                            event.currentTarget.value = "";
                        }}
                    />
                </Button>
                <FormField
                    label="Upload description"
                    value={uploadDescription}
                    onChange={(event: any) => setUploadDescription(event.target.value)} />
                {documents.length > 0 ? (
                    <div className="flex gap-ui-xs">
                        {documents.map((document) => (
                            <div key={document.id} className="surface-card ui-feature-surface ui-feature-surface-dense">
                                <p>{document.title}</p>
                                <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                                    {document.chunk_count} chunks • {document.content_type} • {formatDateTime(document.updated_at)}
                                </span>
                            </div>
                        ))}
                    </div>
                ) : (
                    <EmptyState icon={<FileText />} title="No documents indexed" description="Upload source material to power retrieval-augmented runs." />
                )}
            </div>
        </SectionCard>
    );
}

function RetrievalDocumentSelector({ m }: { m: AiStudioModel }) {
    const {
        documents,
        selectedDocumentIds,
        toggleDocument,
        createRunMutation,
    } = m;

    const selectedCount = documents.filter((document) =>
        selectedDocumentIds.includes(document.id),
    ).length;

    return (
        <fieldset
            disabled={createRunMutation.isPending}
            className="min-w-0 flex flex-col gap-ui-sm"
        >
            <legend className="text-body-md font-medium">
                Retrieval documents
            </legend>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-ui-xs">
                <p className="text-body-md text-muted-foreground">
                    Select documents to include as retrieval context.
                </p>

                <Badge variant="secondary">
                    {selectedCount} selected
                </Badge>
            </div>

            {documents.length > 0 ? (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-ui-xs">
                    {documents.map((document) => {
                        const selected = selectedDocumentIds.includes(
                            document.id,
                        );

                        return (
                            <Button
                                key={document.id}
                                type="button"
                                size="category"
                                variant="category"
                                aria-pressed={selected}
                                disabled={createRunMutation.isPending}
                                onClick={() => toggleDocument(document.id)}
                                className="h-auto max-w-full justify-start py-1.5"
                            >
                                {selected ? (
                                    <Check
                                        className="size-(--icon-size-compact) shrink-0"
                                        aria-hidden="true"
                                    />
                                ) : (
                                    <FileText
                                        className="size-(--icon-size-compact) shrink-0"
                                        aria-hidden="true"
                                    />
                                )}

                                <span className="min-w-0 break-words">
                                    {document.title}
                                </span>
                            </Button>
                        );
                    })}
                </div>
            ) : (
                <p className="rounded-lg border border-dashed border-border p-ui-sm text-body-md text-muted-foreground">
                    No retrieval documents are available.
                    You can still execute a prompt without selecting documents.
                </p>
            )}
        </fieldset>
    );
}

function RunDegradationNotice({ run }: { run: AiRun }) {
    if (!run.retrieval_degraded && !run.memory_degraded) {
        return null;
    }

    return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-ui-xs rounded-lg border border-warning/30 bg-warning-soft p-ui-sm">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-ui-xs">
                <TriangleAlert
                    className="size-(--icon-size-md) shrink-0 text-warning-deep"
                    aria-hidden="true"
                />

                {run.retrieval_degraded && (
                    <Badge variant="warning">
                        Retrieval degraded
                    </Badge>
                )}

                {run.memory_degraded && (
                    <Badge variant="warning">
                        Memory degraded
                    </Badge>
                )}
            </div>

            {run.degradation_reason && (
                <p className="break-words text-body-md text-muted-foreground">
                    {run.degradation_reason}
                </p>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}

export function RagDegradedNotice({ result }: { result: Result }) {
    if (!result.retrieval_degraded && !result.memory_degraded && !result.no_context_found) {
        return null;
    }
    const message = result.no_context_found
        ? "No context found. "
        : result.degradation_reason ??
          (result.retrieval_degraded
              ? "Retrieval degraded."
              : result.memory_degraded
                ? "Memory degraded."
                : "");
    return <div role="alert" className="rounded-lg border border-border p-ui-sm text-body-md">{message}</div>;
}

export function MemoryFiltersPanel({ workspace }: Props) {
    const { memoryLevel, setMemoryLevel, setOffset, setSearchResults, projectId, setProjectId, projects, agentId, setAgentId, searchQuery, setSearchQuery, searchMutation, searchResults } = workspace;
    return (
                <SectionCard title="Filters & search" description="Scope by level, project, and agent.">
                    <div className="flex gap-ui-md">
                        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-ui-md flex-wrap">
                            <FormField
                                as="select"
                                label="Memory level"
                                value={memoryLevel}
                                onChange={(e: any) => {
                                    setMemoryLevel(e.target.value);
                                    setOffset(0);
                                    setSearchResults(null);
                                }}>
                                <option value="">All levels</option>
                                {MEMORY_LEVELS.map((level) => (
                                    <option key={level}>
                                        {level}
                                    </option>
                                ))}
                            </FormField>
                            {workspace.projectsEnabled && <FormField
                                as="select"
                                label="Project"
                                value={projectId}
                                onChange={(e: any) => {
                                    setProjectId(e.target.value);
                                    setOffset(0);
                                    setSearchResults(null);
                                }}>
                                <option value="">All projects</option>
                                {projects.map((project) => (
                                    <option key={project.id} value={project.id}>
                                        {project.name}
                                    </option>
                                ))}
                            </FormField>}
                            <FormField
                                label="Agent ID"
                                value={agentId}
                                onChange={(e: any) => {
                                    setAgentId(e.target.value);
                                    setOffset(0);
                                    setSearchResults(null);
                                }} />
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-ui-xs">
                            <FormField
                                label="Search query"
                                value={searchQuery}
                                onChange={(e: any) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)} />
                            <Button
                                variant="default"
                                disabled={!searchQuery.trim() || searchMutation.isPending}
                                onClick={() => searchMutation.mutate()}
                                type="button"
                            ><Search />Search
                                                            </Button>
                            {searchResults ? (
                                <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setSearchResults(null)} type="button">
                                    Clear search
                                </Button>
                            ) : null}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </SectionCard>
    );
}

export function MemoryListPanel({workspace}: Props) {
    const {
        listQuery,
        searchResults,
        displayItems,
        setSelectedId,
        setConfirmDelete,
        offset,
        pageSize,
        setOffset
    } = workspace;
    return (
        <SectionCard title="Memory list"
                     description="Browse or search results. Destructive actions require confirmation.">
            {listQuery.isError && !searchResults ? (
                <QueryErrorAlert
                    error={listQuery.error}
                    fallback="Failed to load memories. Memory service may be disabled."
                    onRetry={() => void listQuery.refetch()}
                />
            ) : (
                <QueryBoundary
                    isLoading={listQuery.isLoading && !searchResults}
                    isError={false}
                >
                    {displayItems.length === 0 ? (
                        <EmptyState
                            icon={<Brain/>}
                            title="No memories"
                            description="Adjust filters or run an agent that writes memory."
                        />
                    ) : (
                        <div className="min-w-0 max-w-full overflow-x-auto">
                            <table className="w-full text-body-md">
                                <thead>
                                <tr className="border-b border-border">
                                    <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">Content</td>
                                    <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">Level</td>
                                    <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">Privacy</td>
                                    <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">Confidence</td>
                                    <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">Updated</td>
                                    <td align="right" className="p-ui-xs align-top">Actions</td>
                                </tr>
                                </thead>
                                <tbody>
                                {displayItems.map((item) => (
                                    <tr
                                        key={item.id}
                                        onClick={() => setSelectedId(item.id)}
                                        className="cursor-pointer border-b border-border">
                                        <td className="ui-table-long-text p-ui-xs align-top">
                                            <p>
                                                {item.content}
                                            </p>
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">
                                            <Badge variant="secondary">
                                                {item.metadata.memory_level}
                                            </Badge>
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">{item.metadata.privacy}</td>
                                        <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">
                                            {item.metadata.confidence.toFixed(2)}
                                        </td>
                                        <td className="p-ui-xs align-top">
                                            {item.updated_at
                                                ? new Date(item.updated_at).toLocaleString()
                                                : "—"}
                                        </td>
                                        <td align="right" className="p-ui-xs align-top">
                                            <Button
                                                variant="destructive"
                                                onClick={(e: any) => {
                                                    e.stopPropagation();
                                                    setConfirmDelete(item);
                                                }}
                                                type="button"><Trash2/>Forget
                                            </Button>
                                        </td>
                                    </tr>
                                ))}
                                </tbody>
                            </table>
                        </div>
                    )}
                    {!searchResults ? (
                        <PaginationControls count={listQuery.data?.total ?? 0} page={Math.floor(offset / pageSize)}
                                            rowsPerPage={pageSize} onPageChange={(page) => setOffset(page * pageSize)}/>
                    ) : null}
                </QueryBoundary>
            )}
        </SectionCard>
    );
}

export function AdminPlatformContent({ config, plans, flags, templates }: { config: PlatformConfig; plans: SubscriptionPlan[]; flags: FeatureFlag[]; templates: EmailTemplate[] }) {
    const model = usePlatformAdminContent(config, plans, flags, templates);
    return <PageShell width="wide"><SettingsTabs /><AdminPlatformStats config={model.configDraft} plans={plans} flags={flags} templates={templates} />
        <CloneConfigSection source={config} model={model} /><PlansSection plans={plans} model={model} />
        <FlagsSection flags={flags} model={model} /><TemplatesSection templates={templates} model={model} />
    </PageShell>;
}

export function AdminSettingsContent(props: Props) {
    const model = useAdminSettingsContent(props.configData, props.databaseSettings, props.activeTab);
    return (
        <PageShell width="wide">
            <SettingsTabs />
            <MetricGrid columns={3}>
                <StatCard label="Config variables" value={props.configData.items.length} description="Environment-backed values available in the settings file" icon={<Settings2 />} />
                <StatCard label="Restart-sensitive" value={props.configData.items.filter((item) => item.requires_restart).length} description="Values likely to require a backend restart after saving" icon={<RotateCcw />} color="warning" />
                <StatCard label="Runtime database settings" value={props.databaseSettings.length} description="Key/value records stored in the database for live updates" icon={<HardDrive />} color="secondary" />
            </MetricGrid>
            {props.hasConfigError && <div role="alert" className="rounded-lg border border-border p-ui-sm text-body-md">{props.configErrorMessage}</div>}
            {props.hasDatabaseError && <div role="alert" className="rounded-lg border border-border p-ui-sm text-body-md">{props.databaseErrorMessage}</div>}
            <Tabs
                value={props.activeTab}
                onValueChange={(value) => {
                    const nextTab = value === "database"
                        ? value
                        : model.configGroups.find((group) => group.id === value)?.id;
                    if (nextTab) props.onTabChange(nextTab);
                }}
                className="min-w-0"
            >
                <TabsList variant="line" aria-label="Settings category" className="mb-ui-md max-w-full overflow-x-auto border-b border-border">
                    {model.configGroups.map((group) => (
                        <TabsTrigger key={group.id} value={group.id} className="shrink-0 px-ui-sm py-ui-xs">
                            {group.label}
                        </TabsTrigger>
                    ))}
                    <TabsTrigger value="database" className="shrink-0 px-ui-sm py-ui-xs">Database</TabsTrigger>
                </TabsList>
                {model.configGroups.map((group) => (
                    <TabsPanel key={group.id} value={group.id}>
                        {props.activeTab === group.id ? <ConfigSettingsSection configData={props.configData} model={model} /> : null}
                    </TabsPanel>
                ))}
                <TabsPanel value="database">
                    {props.activeTab === "database" ? <DatabaseSettingsSections settings={props.databaseSettings} model={model} /> : null}
                </TabsPanel>
            </Tabs>
        </PageShell>
    );
}

export function PlansSection({ plans, model }: { plans: SubscriptionPlan[]; model: PlatformAdminModel }) {
    const create = model.newPlan;
    return (
        <SectionCard title="Subscription plans" description="Create new commercial tiers and tune existing plans."><div className="flex gap-ui-lg">
                                <div className="surface-card ui-feature-surface"><div className="flex gap-ui-sm">
                                    <p>Create plan</p>
                                    <FormGrid columns="4">
                                        <FormField label="Code" value={create.code} onChange={(e: any) => model.setNewPlan((v) => ({ ...v, code: e.target.value }))} />
                                        <FormField label="Name" value={create.name} onChange={(e: any) => model.setNewPlan((v) => ({ ...v, name: e.target.value }))} />
                                        <FormField label="Price (cents)" value={create.price_cents} onChange={(e: any) => model.setNewPlan((v) => ({ ...v, price_cents: e.target.value }))} />
                                        <FormField label="Interval" value={create.interval} onChange={(e: any) => model.setNewPlan((v) => ({ ...v, interval: e.target.value }))} />
                                    </FormGrid>
                                    <FormField label="Description" value={create.description} onChange={(e: any) => model.setNewPlan((v) => ({ ...v, description: e.target.value }))} />
                                    <FormField label="Features" value={create.features} onChange={(e: any) => model.setNewPlan((v) => ({ ...v, features: e.target.value }))} description="Comma-separated feature labels" />
                                    <Switch
                                        aria-label="Make new plan the default"
                                        checked={create.is_default}
                                        onCheckedChange={(checked) => model.setNewPlan((v) => ({ ...v, is_default: checked }))}
                                    />
                                    <Button
                                        variant="default"
                                        disabled={model.createPlanMutation.isPending || create.code.trim().length < 2}
                                        onClick={() => model.createPlanMutation.mutate({ code: create.code.trim(), name: create.name.trim(), description: create.description.trim() || undefined, price_cents: Number(create.price_cents), interval: create.interval.trim(), is_default: create.is_default, features: create.features.split(",").map((v) => v.trim()).filter(Boolean) })}
                                        type="button">{model.createPlanMutation.isPending ? "Creating..." : "Create plan"}</Button>
                                </div></div>
                                <div className="flex gap-ui-sm">{plans.map((plan) => { const d = model.planDrafts[plan.id]; const saving = model.updatePlanMutation.isPending && model.updatePlanMutation.variables?.id === plan.id; return (
                                    <div key={plan.id} className="surface-card ui-feature-surface"><div className="flex gap-ui-sm">
                                                            <div className="flex flex-row gap-ui-xs items-center"><p>{plan.code}</p>{plan.is_default && <Badge variant="secondary">Default</Badge>}</div>
                                                            <FormGrid columns="4">
                                                                <FormField label="Name" value={d.name} onChange={(e: any) => model.setPlanDrafts((v) => ({ ...v, [plan.id]: { ...d, name: e.target.value } }))} />
                                                                <FormField label="Price (cents)" value={d.price_cents} onChange={(e: any) => model.setPlanDrafts((v) => ({ ...v, [plan.id]: { ...d, price_cents: e.target.value } }))} />
                                                                <FormField label="Interval" value={d.interval} onChange={(e: any) => model.setPlanDrafts((v) => ({ ...v, [plan.id]: { ...d, interval: e.target.value } }))} />
                                                                <FormField label="Features" value={d.features} onChange={(e: any) => model.setPlanDrafts((v) => ({ ...v, [plan.id]: { ...d, features: e.target.value } }))} />
                                                            </FormGrid>
                                                            <FormField label="Description" value={d.description} onChange={(e: any) => model.setPlanDrafts((v) => ({ ...v, [plan.id]: { ...d, description: e.target.value } }))} />
                                                            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-ui-xs"><Switch
                                                                    aria-label={`Activate plan ${plan.code}`}
                                                                    checked={d.is_active}
                                                                    onCheckedChange={(checked) => model.setPlanDrafts((v) => ({ ...v, [plan.id]: { ...d, is_active: checked } }))}
                                                                /><Switch
                                                                    aria-label={`Make plan ${plan.code} the default`}
                                                                    checked={d.is_default}
                                                                    onCheckedChange={(checked) => model.setPlanDrafts((v) => ({ ...v, [plan.id]: { ...d, is_default: checked } }))}
                                                                /></div>
                                                            <Button
                                                                variant="outline"
                                                                disabled={saving}
                                                                onClick={() => model.updatePlanMutation.mutate({ id: plan.id, draft: d })}
                                                                type="button">{saving ? "Saving..." : "Save plan"}</Button>
                                                        </div></div>
                                ); })}</div>
                            </div></SectionCard>
    );
}

export function BillingSection({ m }: { m: PlatformModel }) { const plans = m.plansQuery.data; const subscription = m.subscriptionQuery.data; return (
  <SectionCard title="Billing" description="Review plans and switch when your usage changes.">{(m.subscriptionQuery.isError || m.plansQuery.isError) && <QueryErrorAlert error={m.subscriptionQuery.error ?? m.plansQuery.error} fallback="Failed to load billing data." onRetry={() => { void m.subscriptionQuery.refetch(); void m.plansQuery.refetch(); }} />}{m.subscriptionQuery.isLoading || m.plansQuery.isLoading ? <ResponsiveCardGrid columns={3}>{Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => <Skeleton key={i} className="h-50" />)}</ResponsiveCardGrid> : <div className="flex gap-ui-md"><div role="alert" className="rounded-lg border border-border p-ui-sm text-body-md">Current plan: {subscription?.plan.name ?? "No plan selected"}</div>{!plans?.length ? <EmptyState icon={<Zap />} title="No subscription plans yet" description="Plans will appear here once billing is configured for your workspace." /> : <ResponsiveCardGrid columns={3}>{plans.map((plan) => { const current = subscription?.plan.code === plan.code; return (
      <div key={plan.id} className="surface-card ui-feature-surface" data-selected={current}><div className="flex gap-ui-sm"><div className="flex flex-col xl:flex-row justify-between"><div><h6>{plan.name}</h6><p>{plan.description || "Subscription plan"}</p></div><p>{formatCurrency(plan.price_cents)}/{plan.interval}</p></div><div className="flex flex-row gap-ui-xs flex-wrap">{plan.features.map((feature) => <Badge key={feature} variant="outline">{feature}</Badge>)}</div><Button
          variant={current ? "outline" : "default"}
          disabled={m.selectPlanMutation.isPending || current}
          onClick={() => m.selectPlanMutation.mutate(plan.code)}
          type="button">{current ? "Current plan" : "Switch plan"}</Button></div></div>
    ); })}</ResponsiveCardGrid>}</div>}</SectionCard>
); }

export default function AdminPlatformPage() {
    const config = useQuery({ queryKey: queryKeys.platform.admin.config, queryFn: ({ signal }) => getPlatformConfig({ signal }) });
    const plans = useQuery({ queryKey: queryKeys.platform.admin.plans, queryFn: ({ signal }) => listAdminPlans({ signal }) });
    const flags = useQuery({ queryKey: queryKeys.platform.admin.featureFlags, queryFn: ({ signal }) => listAdminFeatureFlags({ signal }) });
    const templates = useQuery({ queryKey: queryKeys.platform.admin.emailTemplates, queryFn: ({ signal }) => listAdminEmailTemplates({ signal }) });
    if ([config, plans, flags, templates].some((query) => query.isLoading)) return (
        <PageShell width="wide"><div className="flex gap-ui-md"><div

                className="animate-pulse rounded-md bg-muted rounded-lg" /><div

                className="animate-pulse rounded-md bg-muted rounded-lg" /><div

                className="animate-pulse rounded-md bg-muted rounded-lg" /></div></PageShell>
    );
    if (!config.data || !plans.data || !flags.data || !templates.data) return (
        <PageShell width="wide"><SettingsTabs /><div className="mt-ui-md flex gap-ui-md">
            {!config.data && <QueryErrorAlert error={config.error ?? new Error("Failed to load platform configuration.")} fallback="Failed to load platform configuration." title="Configuration" onRetry={() => void config.refetch()} />}
            {!plans.data && <QueryErrorAlert error={plans.error ?? new Error("Failed to load subscription plans.")} fallback="Failed to load subscription plans." title="Plans" onRetry={() => void plans.refetch()} />}
            {!flags.data && <QueryErrorAlert error={flags.error ?? new Error("Failed to load feature flags.")} fallback="Failed to load feature flags." title="Feature flags" onRetry={() => void flags.refetch()} />}
            {!templates.data && <QueryErrorAlert error={templates.error ?? new Error("Failed to load email templates.")} fallback="Failed to load email templates." title="Email templates" onRetry={() => void templates.refetch()} />}
        </div></PageShell>
    );
    return <AdminPlatformContent key={platformAdminKey(config.data, plans.data, flags.data, templates.data)} config={config.data} plans={plans.data} flags={flags.data} templates={templates.data} />;
}

export default function PlatformPage() { const m = usePlatformView(); const metadata = m.metadataQuery.data;
    if (m.metadataQuery.isLoading) return (
        <div className="grid min-h-screen place-items-center"><div

                className="animate-pulse rounded-md bg-muted rounded-lg" /></div>
    );
    if (!metadata) return <PageShell width="wide"><SettingsTabs /><QueryErrorAlert error={m.metadataQuery.error ?? new Error("Failed to load platform metadata.")} fallback="Failed to load platform metadata." onRetry={() => void m.metadataQuery.refetch()} /></PageShell>;
    const visible = metadata.module_catalog.filter((item) => item.user_visible && item.enabled);
    return <PageShell width="wide"><SettingsTabs /><MetricGrid columns={4}><StatCard label="Current plan" value={m.subscriptionQuery.data?.plan.name ?? "No plan"} description="Subscription tier currently selected" icon={<Zap />} loading={m.enabled.billing && m.subscriptionQuery.isLoading} /><StatCard label="API keys" value={m.apiKeysQuery.data?.length ?? 0} description="Developer credentials available" icon={<KeyRound />} color="secondary" /><StatCard label="Webhooks" value={m.webhooksQuery.data?.length ?? 0} description="Outbound delivery endpoints configured" icon={<Webhook />} color="warning" /><StatCard label="Feature flags" value={m.flagsQuery.data?.filter((f) => f.effective_enabled).length ?? 0} description="Flags currently enabled for your account" icon={<Flag />} color="success" /></MetricGrid>{visible.length === 0 && <div role="alert" className="rounded-lg border border-border p-ui-sm text-body-md">The active module pack does not expose any end-user platform modules right now.</div>}{m.enabled.billing && <BillingSection m={m} />}{m.enabled.apiKeys && <ApiKeysSection m={m} />}{m.enabled.webhooks && <WebhooksSection m={m} />}{m.enabled.flags && <FlagsSection m={m} />}</PageShell>;
}

export function RagDocumentsPanel({ workspace, fileInputRef, onTabChange }: Props) {
    const selectedDocumentId = workspace.selectedDocumentId;
    return (
                
                    <SectionCard
                        title="Documents"
                        description="Upload sources and monitor parsing + indexing state before retrieval."
                        action={
                            <>
                                <input
                                    ref={fileInputRef}
                                    type="file"
                                    hidden
                                    onChange={(e: any) => {
                                        const file = e.target.files?.[0];
                                        if (file) workspace.uploadMutation.mutate(file);
                                        e.target.value = "";
                                    }}
                                />
                                <Button
                                    variant="default"
                                    disabled={workspace.uploadMutation.isPending}
                                    onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                                    type="button"><CloudUpload />Upload
                                                                    </Button>
                            </>
                        }
                    >
                        {workspace.documentsQuery.isError ? (
                            <QueryErrorAlert
                                error={workspace.documentsQuery.error}
                                fallback="Failed to load RAG documents. RAG may be disabled."
                                onRetry={() => void workspace.documentsQuery.refetch()}
                            />
                        ) : (
                            <QueryBoundary isLoading={workspace.documentsQuery.isLoading} isError={false}>
                                <AdvancedDataTable
                                    ariaLabel="RAG documents"
                                    columns={[
                                        {
                                            id: "document",
                                            header: "Document",
                                            accessorFn: (doc) => doc.original_filename || doc.filename,
                                            cell: (info) => <TruncatedCell maxChars={48}>{String(info.getValue())}</TruncatedCell>,
                                        },
                                        {
                                            id: "parsing",
                                            header: () => (
                                                <HelpTooltip
                                                    termId="parsing_state"
                                                    variant="label"
                                                >
                                                    Parsing
                                                </HelpTooltip>
                                            ),
                                            accessorFn: (doc) => documentPipelineLabel(doc.status).parsing,
                                        },
                                        {
                                            id: "indexing",
                                            header: () => (
                                                <HelpTooltip
                                                    termId="indexing_state"
                                                    variant="label"
                                                >
                                                    Indexing
                                                </HelpTooltip>
                                            ),
                                            accessorFn: (doc) => documentPipelineLabel(doc.status).indexing,
                                        },
                                        {
                                            id: "status",
                                            header: "Status",
                                            accessorFn: (doc) => doc.status,
                                            cell: ({ row }) => <RunStatusBadge status={row.original.status} showRaw />,
                                        },
                                        {
                                            id: "updated",
                                            header: "Updated",
                                            accessorFn: (doc) => new Date(doc.updated_at).toLocaleString(),
                                        },
                                        {
                                            id: "actions",
                                            header: "Actions",
                                            enableHiding: false,
                                            cell: ({ row }) => (
                                                <div className="flex flex-row justify-end gap-ui-xxs">
                                                    <Button
                                                        disabled={workspace.indexMutation.isPending}
                                                        onClick={() => workspace.indexMutation.mutate(row.original.id)}
                                                        type="button"><RefreshCw />Re-index</Button>
                                                    <ConfirmDeleteDocument
                                                        disabled={workspace.deleteMutation.isPending}
                                                        onConfirm={() => workspace.deleteMutation.mutate(row.original.id)}
                                                    />
                                                </div>
                                            ),
                                        },
                                    ] satisfies ColumnDef<(typeof workspace.documents)[number], unknown>[]}
                                    data={workspace.documents}
                                    getRowId={(doc) => doc.id}
                                    showDensityToggle
                                    enableColumnVisibility
                                    stickyHeader
                                    stickyFirstColumn
                                    enableSorting={false}
                                    searchable={false}
                                    manualPagination
                                    pageCount={Math.ceil((workspace.documentsQuery.data?.total ?? 0) / PAGE_SIZE)}
                                    pagination={{ pageIndex: Math.floor(workspace.docOffset / PAGE_SIZE), pageSize: PAGE_SIZE }}
                                    onPaginationChange={(pagination) => workspace.setDocOffset(pagination.pageIndex * PAGE_SIZE)}
                                    pageSizeOptions={[PAGE_SIZE]}
                                    selectedRowId={workspace.selectedDocumentId}
                                    onRowClick={(doc) => {
                                        workspace.setSelectedDocumentId(doc.id);
                                        workspace.setChunkOffset(0);
                                        onTabChange("indexing");
                                    }}
                                    emptyIcon={<CloudUpload />}
                                    emptyTitle="No RAG documents"
                                    emptyDescription="Upload a file to start parsing, chunking, and indexing."
                                />
                            </QueryBoundary>
                        )}
                        {workspace.pollJobId && workspace.jobQuery.data ? (
                            <div className="mt-ui-xs" >
                                <RagIngestionStatus
                                    dense
                                    title="Ingestion job"
                                    job={workspace.jobQuery.data}
                                    onRetry={
                                        selectedDocumentId
                                            ? () => workspace.indexMutation.mutate(selectedDocumentId)
                                            : undefined
                                    }
                                    retryDisabled={workspace.indexMutation.isPending}
                                />
                            </div>
                        ) : null}
                    </SectionCard>
                
    );
}
