export function RagIndexingPanel({ workspace, onTabChange }: Props) {
    const selectedDocument = workspace.selectedDocument;
    return (
                
                    <>
                        {!selectedDocument ? (
                            <SectionCard
                                title="Indexing"
                                description="Select a document to inspect embedding/chunk settings, progress, and chunks."
                            >
                                <EmptyState
                                    icon={<RefreshCw />}
                                    title="No document selected"
                                    description="Choose a document from Documents, then return here to browse chunks and indexing progress."
                                    action={
                                        <Button variant="default" onClick={() => onTabChange("documents")} type="button">
                                            Open Documents
                                        </Button>
                                    }
                                />
                            </SectionCard>
                        ) : (
                            <>
                                <RagIndexingConfiguration workspace={workspace} document={selectedDocument} />
                                <RagChunksPanel workspace={workspace} />
                            </>
                        )}
                    </>
                
    );
}

export function ConfigSettingsSection({configData, model}: Props) {
    const group = model.activeConfigGroup;
    if (!group) return null;
    return (
        <SectionCard title={group.label} description={group.description} action={
                                                                             <Button
                                                                                 variant="default"
                                                                                 disabled={model.configMutation.isPending || model.changedConfigCount === 0}
                                                                                 onClick={() => model.configMutation.mutate({
                                                                                     items: configData.items.map((item) => ({
                                                                                         key: item.key,
                                                                                         value: model.configDrafts[item.key] ?? ""
                                                                                     }))
                                                                                 })}
                                                                                 type="button">
                                                                                 {model.configMutation.isPending ? "Saving..." : "Save all config"}
                                                                             </Button>
                                                                         }>
            <div className="flex gap-ui-md">
                <div role="alert" className="rounded-lg border border-border p-ui-sm text-body-md">{configData.notice}</div>
                {model.configMutation.isSuccess &&
                    <div role="alert" className="rounded-lg border border-border p-ui-sm text-body-md">Config saved. Restart the
                        backend if a startup-bound value changed.</div>}
                {model.configMutation.isError && <div role="alert"
                                                      className="rounded-lg border border-border p-ui-sm text-body-md">{getQueryErrorMessage(model.configMutation.error, "Failed to save config.")}</div>}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-ui-xs">
                    <Badge variant="outline">
                        {group.items.length} variables in this group
                    </Badge>

                    <Badge
                        variant={model.changedConfigCount > 0
                            ? "warning"
                            : "outline"}
                    >
                        {model.changedConfigCount > 0
                            ? `${model.changedConfigCount} unsaved changes across all tabs`
                            : "No unsaved config changes"}
                    </Badge>
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-ui-sm">
                    {group.items.map((item) => <ConfigEntryEditor key={item.key} item={item}
                                                                  value={model.configDrafts[item.key] ?? item.value}
                                                                  onChange={(value) => model.setConfigDrafts((current) => ({
                                                                      ...current,
                                                                      [item.key]: value
                                                                  }))}/>)}
                </div>
            </div>
        </SectionCard>
    );
}

export function DatabaseSettingsSections({ settings, model }: { settings: DatabaseSetting[]; model: AdminSettingsModel }) {
    const create = model.createDatabaseMutation;
    return (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-ui-md">
            <SectionCard title="Add database setting" description="Store arbitrary key/value settings inside the database.">
                <div className="flex gap-ui-md">
                    {create.isSuccess && <div role="alert" className="rounded-lg border border-border p-ui-sm text-body-md">Database setting created.</div>}
                    {create.isError && <div role="alert" className="rounded-lg border border-border p-ui-sm text-body-md">{getQueryErrorMessage(create.error, "Failed to create database setting.")}</div>}
                    <FormField
                        label="Key"
                        value={model.newSetting.key}
                        onChange={(event: any) => model.setNewSetting((current) => ({ ...current, key: event.target.value }))} />
                    <FormField
                        label="Value"
                        value={model.newSetting.value}
                        onChange={(event: any) => model.setNewSetting((current) => ({ ...current, value: event.target.value }))}
                        as="textarea"
                        rows={3} />
                    <FormField
                        label="Description"
                        value={model.newSetting.description}
                        onChange={(event: any) => model.setNewSetting((current) => ({ ...current, description: event.target.value }))}
                        as="textarea"
                        rows={3} />
                    <Button
                        variant="default"
                        disabled={create.isPending || !model.newSetting.key.trim()}
                        onClick={() => create.mutate({ key: model.newSetting.key.trim(), value: model.newSetting.value, description: model.newSetting.description || undefined })}
                        type="button">
                        {create.isPending ? "Adding..." : "Add setting"}
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </SectionCard>
            <SectionCard title="Database settings" description="Review, edit, and delete runtime settings stored in the database.">
                {settings.length > 0 ? <div className="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-ui-sm">
                    {settings.map((item) => {
                        const draft = model.databaseDrafts[item.id] ?? { value: item.value, description: item.description ?? "" };
                        return <DatabaseSettingEditor key={item.id} item={item} draft={draft}
                            onDraftChange={(next) => model.setDatabaseDrafts((current) => ({ ...current, [item.id]: next }))}
                            onSave={() => model.updateDatabaseMutation.mutate({ id: item.id, ...draft })}
                            onDelete={() => model.deleteDatabaseMutation.mutate(item.id)}
                            isSaving={model.updateDatabaseMutation.isPending && model.updateDatabaseMutation.variables?.id === item.id}
                            isDeleting={model.deleteDatabaseMutation.isPending && model.deleteDatabaseMutation.variables === item.id} />;
                    })}
                </div> : <EmptyState icon={<HardDrive />} title="No database settings yet" description="Create a setting when you need runtime-configurable values stored in the database." />}
            </SectionCard>
        </div>
    );
}

describe("useNotifications", () => {
    beforeEach(() => {
        vi.mocked(getNotifications).mockResolvedValue([
            {
                id: "n1",
                type: "system",
                title: "Hello",
                body: "World",
                is_read: false,
                created_at: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
            },
        ]);
    });

    it("uses the canonical notifications query key", async () => {
        const queryClient = new QueryClient({
            defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } },
        });

        function TestWrapper({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
            return <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>;
        }

        const { result } = renderHook(() => useNotifications({ refetchInterval: false }), {
            wrapper: TestWrapper,
        });

        await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.isSuccess).toBe(true));
        expect(getNotifications).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        expect(queryClient.getQueryData(queryKeys.notifications.all)).toEqual([
            expect.objectContaining({ id: "n1", title: "Hello" }),
        ]);
    });

    it("defaults to polling unless disabled", () => {
        const wrapper = createWrapper();
        const { result } = renderHook(() => useNotifications(), { wrapper });
        expect(result.current.fetchStatus).toBeDefined();
    });
});

describe("minimal dashboard capability gates", () => {
    afterEach(() => vi.clearAllMocks());

    it("keeps core projects available and hides disabled notifications", async () => {
        vi.mocked(listProjects).mockResolvedValue([]);
        const client = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } });
        render(
            <QueryClientProvider client={client}>
                <MemoryRouter>
                    <DashboardPage />
                </MemoryRouter>
            </QueryClientProvider>,
        );

        expect(screen.getByText("Account health")).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(screen.queryByText("Recent activity")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(screen.getByText("Projects snapshot")).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(listProjects).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
        expect(getNotifications).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        await waitFor(() => expect(client.getQueryCache().find({ queryKey: queryKeys.projects.all })?.state.fetchStatus).toBe("idle"));
        expect(client.getQueryCache().find({ queryKey: queryKeys.notifications.all })?.state.fetchStatus).toBe("idle");
        client.clear();
    });
});

export function recordToKeyValueItems(
    data: unknown,
    options?: { maxEntries?: number }
): JsonKeyValueItem[] {
    if (!data || typeof data !== "object" || Array.isArray(data)) return [];
    const max = options?.maxEntries ?? 24;
    return Object.entries(data as Record<string, unknown>)
        .slice(0, max)
        .map(([key, value]) => ({
            key,
            label: key.replaceAll("_", " "),
            value: formatDisplayValue(value),
        }));
}

export function keyValueItemsFromRecord(
    record: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,
    options?: { maxItems?: number }
): KeyValueItem[] {
    if (!record) return [];
    const maxItems = options?.maxItems ?? 40;
    const items: KeyValueItem[] = [];
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(record)) {
        if (items.length >= maxItems) break;
        if (value != null && typeof value === "object") continue;
        items.push({
            key,
            label: key.replace(/_/g, " "),
            value: formatPrimitive(value),
            helpTermId: helpTermIdForKey(key) ?? undefined,
        });
    }
    return items;
}

export function formatRunDurationMs(ms: number | null | undefined): string {
    if (ms == null || !Number.isFinite(ms) || ms < 0) return "—";
    if (ms < 1000) return `${Math.round(ms)} ms`;
    const seconds = ms / 1000;
    if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds.toFixed(1)} s`;
    const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
    const rem = Math.round(seconds % 60);
    return `${minutes}m ${rem}s`;
}

describe("blueprint application configuration", () => {
    it("keeps capability identifiers and backend module packs stable", () => {
        expect(CAPABILITY_IDS).toContain("observability");
        expect(BACKEND_MODULE_KEYS).toEqual(["ai", "billing", "api_keys", "webhooks", "feature_flags", "email_templates"]);
        expect(BACKEND_MODULE_PACK_KEYS).toEqual(["lean_saas", "automation_suite", "client_portal", "full_platform"]);
    });

    it("gates optional capabilities against server availability", () => {
        const configuration = createApplicationConfiguration();
        for (const capability of ["ai", "rag", "agent", "memory", "calendar", "notifications"] as const) {
            expect(capabilityAvailability(capability, configuration, { availableFeatures: [] }).available).toBe(false);
        }
        expect(capabilityAvailability("notifications", configuration, { availableFeatures: ["notifications"] }).available).toBe(true);
        expect(capabilityAvailability("ai", configuration, { availableFeatures: ["ai"], enabledModules: ["ai"] }).available).toBe(true);
    });

    it("respects disabled runtime feature flags", () => {
        const configuration = createApplicationConfiguration();
        expect(capabilityAvailability("dashboard", configuration, { featureFlags: { beta_dashboard: false } }).reasons)
            .toContain("runtime feature flag beta_dashboard is disabled");
    });
});

describe("settings tab visibility", () => {
    it("keeps capability and admin tabs hidden for a basic user", () => {
        expect(paths(false, false, [])).toEqual(["/profile"]);
    });

    it("shows capability tabs independently", () => {
        expect(paths(false, true, [])).toContain("/platform");
        expect(paths(false, false, ["ai"])).toEqual(["/profile", "/ai", "/agent"]);
        expect(paths(false, false, ["rag", "memory"])).toEqual(["/profile", "/rag", "/memory"]);
    });

    it("shows notifications only when the capability is enabled", () => {
        expect(paths(false, false, [])).not.toContain("/notifications");
        expect(paths(false, false, ["notifications"])).toContain("/notifications");
    });

    it("shows all admin tabs only to admins", () => {
        const adminPaths = paths(true, true, ["ai"]);
        expect(adminPaths).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([
            "/admin/settings",
            "/admin/users",
            "/admin/platform",
        ]));
        expect(paths(false, true, ["ai"]).some((path) => path.startsWith("/admin/"))).toBe(false);
    });
});

describe("user session query isolation", () => {
    it("clears user-scoped records before a new identity is published", async () => {
        const client = new QueryClient();
        client.setQueryData(queryKeys.projects.all, [{ id: "old-user-project" }]);
        client.setQueryData(queryKeys.users.profile, { user_id: "old-user" });

        await clearUserSessionCache(client);

        expect(client.getQueryData(queryKeys.projects.all)).toBeUndefined();
        expect(client.getQueryData(queryKeys.users.profile)).toBeUndefined();
        client.clear();
    });

    it.each([
        ["logout", clearUserSessionCache],
        ["sign-in", resetUserSessionCache],
    ] as const)("preserves only the public metadata query on %s", async (_transition, reset) => {
        const client = new QueryClient();
        const metadata = { app_name: "Fullstack Blueprint" };
        const scopedMetadataKey = [...queryKeys.platform.metadata, "user-1"];
        client.setQueryData(queryKeys.platform.metadata, metadata);
        client.setQueryData(scopedMetadataKey, { permissions: ["private"] });
        client.setQueryData(queryKeys.projects.all, [{ id: "private-project" }]);
        client.setQueryData(queryKeys.platform.subscription, { plan: "private-plan" });
        client.getMutationCache().build(client, { mutationKey: ["private-mutation"] });

        await reset(client);

        expect(client.getQueryData(queryKeys.platform.metadata)).toEqual(metadata);
        expect(client.getQueryData(scopedMetadataKey)).toBeUndefined();
        expect(client.getQueryData(queryKeys.projects.all)).toBeUndefined();
        expect(client.getQueryData(queryKeys.platform.subscription)).toBeUndefined();
        expect(client.getMutationCache().getAll()).toHaveLength(0);
        client.clear();
    });
});

export function useAiPromptAssetMutations(forms: AiStudioForms) {
    const client = useQueryClient();
    const toastError = useMutationErrorToast();
    const refreshVersions = () => client.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: queryKeys.ai.promptVersions(forms.selectedTemplateId),
    });
    const createTemplateMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: createPromptTemplate,
        onSuccess: async () => { forms.setTemplateForm({ key: "", name: "", description: "" }); await invalidateAiOverview(client); notify({ message: "Prompt template created.", severity: "success" }); },
        onError: (error) => toastError(error, "Failed to create prompt template.") });
    const createVersionMutation = useMutation({
        mutationFn: ({ templateId, payload }: { templateId: string; payload: Parameters<typeof createPromptVersion>[1] }) => createPromptVersion(templateId, payload),
        onSuccess: async () => { await invalidateAiOverview(client); await refreshVersions(); notify({ message: "Prompt version created.", severity: "success" }); },
        onError: (error) => toastError(error, "Failed to create prompt version."),
    });
    const activateVersionMutation = useMutation({
        mutationFn: ({ templateId, versionId }: { templateId: string; versionId: string }) => updatePromptTemplate(templateId, { active_version_id: versionId }),
        onSuccess: async () => { await invalidateAiOverview(client); notify({ message: "Active prompt version updated.", severity: "success" }); },
        onError: (error) => toastError(error, "Failed to update active prompt version."),
    });
    const publishVersionMutation = useMutation({
        mutationFn: ({ templateId, versionId, isPublished }: { templateId: string; versionId: string; isPublished: boolean }) => updatePromptVersion(templateId, versionId, { is_published: isPublished }),
        onSuccess: async () => { await refreshVersions(); notify({ message: "Prompt version updated.", severity: "success" }); },
        onError: (error) => toastError(error, "Failed to update prompt version."),
    });
    const createTextDocumentMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: createAiDocument,
        onSuccess: async () => { forms.setTextDocumentForm({ title: "", description: "", content: "", content_type: "text/plain" }); await invalidateAiOverview(client); notify({ message: "Document queued for indexing.", severity: "success" }); },
        onError: (error) => toastError(error, "Failed to ingest document.") });
    const uploadDocumentMutation = useMutation({
        mutationFn: ({ file, description }: { file: File; description?: string }) => uploadAiDocument(file, description),
        onSuccess: async () => { forms.setUploadDescription(""); await invalidateAiOverview(client); notify({ message: "Document uploaded and queued for indexing.", severity: "success" }); },
        onError: (error) => toastError(error, "Failed to upload document."),
    });
    return { createTemplateMutation, createVersionMutation, activateVersionMutation,
        publishVersionMutation, createTextDocumentMutation, uploadDocumentMutation };
}

export function useAiRunEvaluationMutations(forms: AiStudioForms) {
    const client = useQueryClient();
    const toastError = useMutationErrorToast();
    const createRunMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: createAiRun,
        onSuccess: async () => { await invalidateAiOverview(client); await client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.ai.reviews }); notify({ message: "AI run completed.", severity: "success" }); },
        onError: (error) => toastError(error, "Failed to run prompt.") });
    const createReviewMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: (runId: string) => createAiReview(runId),
        onSuccess: async () => { await client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.ai.reviews }); notify({ message: "Review requested.", severity: "success" }); },
        onError: (error) => toastError(error, "Failed to create review.") });
    const decideReviewMutation = useMutation({
        mutationFn: ({ reviewId, status, reviewer_notes, corrected_output }: { reviewId: string; status: "approved" | "rejected" | "changes_requested"; reviewer_notes?: string; corrected_output?: string }) => decideAiReview(reviewId, { status, reviewer_notes, corrected_output }),
        onSuccess: async () => { await client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.ai.reviews }); notify({ message: "Review decision saved.", severity: "success" }); },
        onError: (error) => toastError(error, "Failed to save review decision."),
    });
    const createFeedbackMutation = useMutation({
        mutationFn: ({ runId, rating, comment, corrected_output }: { runId: string; rating: -1 | 1; comment?: string; corrected_output?: string }) => createAiFeedback(runId, { rating, comment, corrected_output }),
        onSuccess: () => notify({ message: "Feedback saved.", severity: "success" }),
        onError: (error) => toastError(error, "Failed to save feedback."),
    });
    const createDatasetMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: createAiDataset,
        onSuccess: async (dataset) => { forms.setDatasetForm({ name: "", description: "" }); forms.setSelectedDatasetId(dataset.id); await invalidateAiOverview(client); notify({ message: "Evaluation dataset created.", severity: "success" }); },
        onError: (error) => toastError(error, "Failed to create evaluation dataset.") });
    const createDatasetCaseMutation = useMutation({
        mutationFn: ({ datasetId, payload }: { datasetId: string; payload: Parameters<typeof createAiDatasetCase>[1] }) => createAiDatasetCase(datasetId, payload),
        onSuccess: async () => { forms.setSelectedEvaluationDocumentIds([]); await client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.ai.datasetCases(forms.selectedDatasetId) }); notify({ message: "Evaluation case added.", severity: "success" }); },
        onError: (error) => toastError(error, "Failed to add evaluation case."),
    });
    const runEvaluationMutation = useMutation({
        mutationFn: ({ datasetId, promptVersionId }: { datasetId: string; promptVersionId: string }) => runAiEvaluation(datasetId, promptVersionId),
        onSuccess: async () => { await client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.ai.evaluationRuns }); notify({ message: "Evaluation started. Results will update when complete.", severity: "success" }); },
        onError: (error) => toastError(error, "Failed to run evaluation."),
    });
    return { createRunMutation, createReviewMutation, decideReviewMutation,
        createFeedbackMutation, createDatasetMutation, createDatasetCaseMutation,
        runEvaluationMutation };
}

            return jobPollInterval(Math.max(0, Date.now() - createdAt));

describe("AI SSE boundary", () => {
    it("parses multiline data and event metadata without executing content", () => {
        expect(parseSseFrame("event: text_delta\nid: e-1\ndata: {\"runId\":\"r\"}\n\ndata: {\"messageId\":\"m\"}")?.id).toBe("e-1");

    it("reads typed JSON events from a response body", async () => {
        const body = "event: run_started\nid: e-1\ndata: {\"runId\":\"r\"}\n\n";
        const response = new Response(new ReadableStream({ start(controller) { controller.enqueue(new TextEncoder().encode(body)); controller.close(); } }), { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/event-stream" } });
        const events = [];
        for await (const event of readAiStream(response)) events.push(event);
        expect(events).toEqual([{ type: "run_started", runId: "r", eventId: "e-1" }]);
    });
});

describe("AI workspace event contract", () => {
    it("validates trusted events and ignores duplicate event ids", () => {
        const event = parseAiStreamEvent({ type: "text_delta", runId: "run-1", messageId: "message-1", delta: "Hello", eventId: "event-1" });
        const started = reduceAiWorkspaceEvent(emptyAiWorkspaceState, { type: "message_started", runId: "run-1", messageId: "message-1", role: "assistant", eventId: "start" });
        const next = reduceAiWorkspaceEvent(reduceAiWorkspaceEvent(started, event), event);
        expect(next.messages[0]?.content).toBe("Hello");
        expect(next.seenEventIds).toEqual(["start", "event-1"]);
    });

    it("rejects unsupported or malformed events", () => {
        expect(() => parseAiStreamEvent({ type: "tool_call_started", runId: "run-1" })).toThrow("invalid AI stream event");
        expect(() => parseAiStreamEvent({ type: "unknown", runId: "run-1" })).toThrow("invalid AI stream event");
    });
});

    const subscriptionQuery = useQuery({ queryKey: queryKeys.platform.subscription, queryFn: ({ signal }) => getMySubscription({ signal }), enabled: enabled.billing });
    const apiKeysQuery = useQuery({ queryKey: queryKeys.platform.apiKeys, queryFn: ({ signal }) => listApiKeys({ signal }), enabled: enabled.apiKeys });

    const [apiKeyName, setApiKeyName] = useState(""); const [apiKeyNameError, setApiKeyNameError] = useState<string | null>(null); const [revealedKey, setRevealedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [webhookDraft, setWebhookDraft] = useState({ target_url: "", description: "", events: "platform.test" }); const [webhookUrlError, setWebhookUrlError] = useState<string | null>(null);
    const [revealedWebhookSecret, setRevealedWebhookSecret] = useState<string | null>(null); const [lastWebhookResult, setLastWebhookResult] = useState("");
    const selectPlanMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: selectMyPlan, onSuccess: async () => { await client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.platform.subscription }); notify({ message: "Subscription updated.", severity: "success" }); }, onError: (e: any) => toastError(e, "Failed to update subscription.") });
    const createApiKeyMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: createApiKey, onSuccess: async (data) => { setApiKeyName(""); setRevealedKey(data.plaintext_key); await client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.platform.apiKeys }); }, onError: (e: any) => toastError(e, "Failed to create API key.") });

    const createWebhookMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: createWebhook, onSuccess: async (data) => { setWebhookDraft({ target_url: "", description: "", events: "platform.test" }); setRevealedWebhookSecret(data.signing_secret); await client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.platform.webhooks }); notify({ message: "Webhook created.", severity: "success" }); }, onError: (e: any) => toastError(e, "Failed to create webhook.") });
    const toggleWebhookMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: ({ id, is_active }: { id: string; is_active: boolean }) => updateWebhook(id, { is_active }), onMutate: async ({ id, is_active }) => { await client.cancelQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.platform.webhooks }); const previous = client.getQueryData<WebhookEndpoint[]>(queryKeys.platform.webhooks); client.setQueryData<WebhookEndpoint[]>(queryKeys.platform.webhooks, (old) => old?.map((item) => item.id === id ? { ...item, is_active } : item)); return { previous }; }, onError: (e: any, _v: any, context: any) => { if (context?.previous) client.setQueryData(queryKeys.platform.webhooks, context.previous); toastError(e, "Failed to update webhook."); }, onSettled: () => void client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.platform.webhooks }) });
    const deleteWebhookMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: deleteWebhook, onSuccess: async () => { await client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.platform.webhooks }); notify({ message: "Webhook deleted.", severity: "success" }); }, onError: (e: any) => toastError(e, "Failed to delete webhook.") });
    const testWebhookMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: testWebhook, onSuccess: (r) => setLastWebhookResult(r.delivered ? `Delivered with status ${r.status_code}.` : r.error ? `Delivery failed: ${r.error}` : `Received status ${r.status_code}.`), onError: (e: any) => toastError(e, "Failed to test webhook.") });
    const submitWebhook = () => { const target_url = webhookDraft.target_url.trim(); const parsed = urlSchema.safeParse(target_url); if (!parsed.success) { setWebhookUrlError(parsed.error.issues[0]?.message ?? "Invalid URL"); return; } createWebhookMutation.mutate({ target_url, description: webhookDraft.description.trim() || undefined, events: webhookDraft.events.split(",").map((item) => item.trim()).filter(Boolean) }); };

export function useProfileView() { const client = useQueryClient(); const toastError = useMutationErrorToast(); const userQuery = useCurrentUser(); const profileQuery = useUserProfile(); const sessionsQuery = useUserSessions();
    const accountForm = useForm<AccountValues>({ resolver: zodResolver(accountSchema), values: { full_name: userQuery.data?.full_name ?? "" } });
    const profileForm = useForm<ProfileValues>({ resolver: zodResolver(profileSchema), values: { bio: profileQuery.data?.bio ?? "", location: profileQuery.data?.location ?? "", website: profileQuery.data?.website ?? "" } });
    const passwordForm = useForm<PasswordValues>({ resolver: zodResolver(passwordSchema) }); const mfaVerifyForm = useForm<MfaCodeValues>({ resolver: zodResolver(mfaCodeSchema) }); const mfaDisableForm = useForm<MfaCodeValues>({ resolver: zodResolver(mfaCodeSchema) });
    const accountMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: updateMe, onSuccess: async () => { await invalidateUserIdentity(client); }, onError: (e: any) => toastError(e, "Failed to update account info.") });
    const profileMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: updateProfile, onSuccess: () => void client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.users.profile }), onError: (e: any) => toastError(e, "Failed to update public profile.") });
    const passwordMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: changePassword, onSuccess: () => passwordForm.reset(), onError: (e: any) => toastError(e, "Failed to update password.") });
    const revokeSessionMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: revokeSession, onSuccess: () => void client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.users.sessions }), onError: (e: any) => toastError(e, "Failed to revoke session.") });
    const enableMfaMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: enableMfa, onError: (e: any) => toastError(e, "Failed to start MFA setup.") });
    const verifyMfaMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: (v: MfaCodeValues) => verifyMfa(v.code), onSuccess: async () => { mfaVerifyForm.reset(); await invalidateUserIdentity(client); notify({ message: "MFA enabled.", severity: "success" }); }, onError: (e: any) => toastError(e, "Failed to verify MFA.") });
    const disableMfaMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: (v: MfaCodeValues) => disableMfa(v.code), onSuccess: async () => { mfaDisableForm.reset(); await invalidateUserIdentity(client); notify({ message: "MFA disabled.", severity: "success" }); }, onError: (e: any) => toastError(e, "Failed to disable MFA.") });
    const avatarSuccess = async (message: string) => { await client.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: queryKeys.users.profile }); notify({ message, severity: "success" }); };
    const uploadAvatarMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: uploadAvatar, onSuccess: () => avatarSuccess("Avatar updated."), onError: (e: any) => notify({ message: getQueryErrorMessage(e, "Failed to upload avatar."), severity: "error" }) });
    const deleteAvatarMutation = useMutation({ mutationFn: deleteAvatar, onSuccess: () => avatarSuccess("Avatar removed."), onError: (e: any) => notify({ message: getQueryErrorMessage(e, "Failed to remove avatar."), severity: "error" }) });
    return { userQuery, profileQuery, sessionsQuery, accountForm, profileForm, passwordForm, mfaVerifyForm, mfaDisableForm, accountMutation, profileMutation, passwordMutation, revokeSessionMutation, enableMfaMutation, verifyMfaMutation, disableMfaMutation, uploadAvatarMutation, deleteAvatarMutation };
}

export function useSettingsTabs(): SettingsTab[] {
    const { isAdmin } = useAuth();
    const { t } = useTranslation();
    const { data: platformMetadata } = usePlatformMetadata();
    const configuration = useApplicationConfiguration();
    const hasUserPlatformModule =
        platformMetadata?.module_catalog.some((item) => item.user_visible && item.enabled) ?? false;
    const features = platformMetadata?.available_features ?? NO_FEATURES;

    return useMemo(
        () => getVisibleSettingsTabs({ isAdmin, hasUserPlatformModule, features, configuration, server: serverStateFromPlatformMetadata(platformMetadata) })
            .map((item) => ({ path: item.path, label: t(item.translationKey) })),
        [configuration, features, hasUserPlatformModule, isAdmin, platformMetadata, t]
    );
}
